content.caseIdentity: Samar Ghosh v. Jaya Ghosh, (2007) 4 SCC 511
content.facts: The Supreme Court considered a dispute requiring interpretation of the governing family-law provision or closely connected statutory rule.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the correct legal interpretation and application of the governing statutory rule?
content.ratioDecidendi: Mental cruelty is fact-sensitive; the Court supplied illustrative categories while emphasizing that the statutory matrimonial ground must be proved on the facts.
content.holding: Mental cruelty is fact-sensitive; the Court supplied illustrative categories while emphasizing that the statutory matrimonial ground must be proved on the facts.
